expected_spec.initial_state: standing upright on the wooden coffee table
expected_spec.intended_change: tilted onto its side to create a small local spill
expected_spec.completion_criteria: mug is visibly tilted with liquid spilled on the table surface
negative_constraints: do not spill liquid beyond the immediate vicinity of the mug
do not move or alter the mug's base position on the table
do not change the mug's material or color
failure_modes: mug remains upright with no spill
mug is moved off the table
spill is too large or affects unrelated scene elements
camera or background elements are altered
